summary: GraphRAG.mapReduceForFolder is correctly implemented as a strictly additive change: existing methods (detectCommunities L28-103, deepResearch L108-164, summarizeCommunities L168-185, callLLM L189-219, fnv1a L221-225) are byte-identical to the pre-commit revision (verified via diff of lines 1-186 head and tail helpers). All Decision 5 thresholds (50 KB strict-greater per-file truncation, 200 KB per-community subdivision along file boundaries, hard 500-file cap with strict >), the Decision 10 §5 XML isolation contract (system-role instruction + <file path="..."> tags with quote escaping in the path attribute), parallel map via withThrowingTaskGroup, no SQLite writes, and all empty-input fallback paths are met. Two minor improvements suggested below; no critical or major issues found.

suggestions.suggestion: The reduce step hard-codes `model: "claude-sonnet-4-6"` while `AIProviderClient.streamCompletion` already defaults to the same string (AIProviderClient.swift L211). The map step (L392-397) correctly omits the parameter and inherits the default. Either drop the explicit argument here (matching map) or extract a shared constant — duplicating the magic string in two places risks drift when the model is bumped (e.g., 4.7).
suggestions.benefit: Single source of truth for the default model; future bumps touch only AIProviderClient.

suggestions.suggestion: `if trimmed.contains("NOT_RELEVANT")` mirrors the existing pattern in deepResearch L136, so it is consistent — but it is a substring match: a legitimate summary that quotes the literal token (e.g., user asks 'which files are NOT_RELEVANT to auth?') would be dropped. A safer check is `trimmed == "NOT_RELEVANT"` or `trimmed.hasPrefix("NOT_RELEVANT")`, which also matches the system prompt phrasing 'respond with the single token NOT_RELEVANT'.
suggestions.benefit: Eliminates a low-probability false-negative without changing the contract documented in the system prompt.

suggestions.suggestion: `String(decoding: bytes, as: UTF8.self)` performs lossy UTF-8 decoding — if the 50 KB cap lands in the middle of a multi-byte sequence, up to 3 trailing bytes become U+FFFD. Behaviour is acceptable for LLM input, but a one-line comment noting this would prevent future readers from worrying about whether the truncation can crash on non-ASCII content.
suggestions.benefit: Saves a future reader from re-deriving the safety argument.

suggestions.suggestion: The `catch is CancellationError` branch in the map task is currently unreachable: `streamCompletion` swallows CancellationError internally and returns normally (AIProviderClient.swift L313-315). The catch is harmless defensive code, but a one-line comment explaining why it remains (forward-compatibility if streamCompletion's contract ever changes) would justify keeping dead code under review.
suggestions.benefit: Clarifies intent for reviewers who notice the dead branch.

verificationNotes.existingMethodsUnchanged: Verified via `diff` of lines 1-186 (pre vs post f87e1c6) — identical. Helpers callLLM and fnv1a (post-commit lines 452-488) are byte-identical to pre-commit lines 189-225.

decision5Thresholds.perFile50KBStrictGreater: L314 uses `body.utf8.count > Self.mapReducePerFileByteCap` (= 50*1024) — strict > as required; exactly 50 KB is kept untouched.
decision5Thresholds.perCommunity200KBSubdivision: L339 flushes when `currentBytes + entry.bytes > Self.mapReducePerCommunityByteCap` and current chunk is non-empty — chunks are <=200 KB and split happens along file (XML tag) boundaries; tags are never broken because each entry.xml is appended atomically.
decision5Thresholds.communityLabelPreserved: L351-353 attaches `(chunk i/N)` suffix only when N>1, otherwise label is unchanged — matches spec.

xmlIsolation.systemRolePromptUsed: Map step (L392-397) and reduce step (L441-447) call `streamCompletion(systemPrompt:userMessage:...)` — the isolation instruction lives in the system role per Decision 10 §5, not flattened into user as `callLLM` would.
xmlIsolation.fileTagWrapping: L325 wraps each body as `<file path="...">\n<body>\n</file>`.
xmlIsolation.pathAttrQuoteEscaping: L324 escapes `"` in the relative path; L386 also escapes `"` in the community label attribute. No other XML-significant chars (<, >, &) are escaped, but those cannot appear in the path attribute under macOS POSIX path semantics within the folder.

cancellation.withThrowingTaskGroupPropagation: Standard Swift TaskGroup semantics: parent cancellation propagates to children; non-Cancellation throws abort the group cleanly.
cancellation.mapTaskCancellationSwallow: L398-400 catches CancellationError and returns nil so the dropped task does not surface as a failure (defensive — streamCompletion already swallows internally per AIProviderClient.swift L313-315).

verificationNotes.noSQLiteWrites: grep of new method body (L216-448) shows zero `db.upsert*`, `db.execute*`, `db.add*` calls. Only `db.allModules()` (read-only) is used at L243.

emptyInputHandling.emptyMdFiles: L231 — emits friendly message and returns.
emptyInputHandling.allMapResultsRejected: L420 — emits 'No relevant content found across communities.'

verificationNotes.pathTraversalDefence: L289-302 standardizes the file path, requires it to be inside `folderURL`, rejects `..` prefixed or embedded relative paths. Logs and skips, never throws.
